Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: first of ten high-fidelity reference screens for an original isometric single-player CRPG, NO MAN'S LAND, in French. Create ONE 16:9 landscape full-screen video game interface concept, not a web dashboard, no browser chrome, no monitor/device frame, no collage.
Screen 01: EXPLORATION IN DUSK-TOWN. Year 2175. Sophisticated gritty post-nuclear South American desert town, ghostlike closed sandy facades but lived-in shaded courtyards, a working community clinic, realistic textured soil, coherent paths to building doors, laundry and shade cloth, restrained decay. Three-quarter isometric view like a richly painted modern successor to Fallout 1/2, not first person. A human traveller in a brown coat with backpack stands near a pump, a mechanic companion a few steps behind; several small townspeople visibly doing work. Rich environment occupies 75%+ of the composition.
UI direction to establish and reuse: precise premium game HUD, dark graphite matte metal panels #141C23, warm ivory clear large sans serif type, small monospaced numerals, very fine warm brass dividers, pale teal selected states #A8DACC, amber caution #E0BF81, red reserved for danger, subtle industrial wear at panel edges. Crisp typography, generous space, visually quiet central field. Contemporary ergonomic spacing, useful affordances, tactile but thin frames, restrained glow. Avoid distressed unreadable fonts, neon overload, giant opaque sidebars and random floating graphs.
Top-left compact place label text exactly "DUSK-TOWN", smaller "JOUR 03 · 08:40". Top-right one short objective "LA DETTE DES VIVANTS" / "Parler à Mara", with a small local minimap beneath, route information only known.
Bottom-left portrait and readable "52 / 60 PV"; tiny secondary "RAD 12%" and companion chip "NILO · SUIT". Bottom-center shallow stable action dock, illustrated pistol in active slot and six clean action symbols with small French labels "Observer", "Parler", "Soins", "Inventaire", "Carte", "Journal". No action points outside combat. Bottom-right compact ammo readout "24 CARTOUCHES" and small menu control.
Near the pump one restrained interaction prompt exactly "EXAMINER · POMPE". One small edge message "Une place au réfectoire vous attend."
No enormous game logo, marketing title, numbered annotations, watermarks, MMO quest spam, shop price banners or invented factions. This is the final visual reference image itself. Render nuanced professional art direction and an actually plausible shippable game UI.
